programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Syrian food is one of the most vibrant cuisines of the Middle East, full of herbs, spices and traditions stretching back many generations. Maeve O'Meara meets up with restaurateur Amal Malouf to get an explanation of the essential ingredients to make traditional dishes. Chef Carol Salloum takes Maeve through the classic mezza spread and explains the custom of eating the generous variety of little dishes while her sister Sharon makes a classic salad called fattoush.

programs.title: The Chocolate Queen
programs.desc: The season finale is a showstopper! Kirsten stuns with leopard-print cupcakes, delicious chocolate lollies, and flawless macarons.

programs.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Johnny Di Francesco joins Justine to make his fig and mascarpone calzone and then Justine makes her duck, mandarin and Brussel sprout salad and some chargrilled butterflied king prawns.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Noodles for one, anyone? Adam and his guests, Lilly Wright from Flying Chillies in Ballarat and comedian Sasha Perera share their solo noodle go-tos.

programs.title: New York Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programs.desc: Justine dives into Hong Kong's culinary scene. She begins at Dai Pai Dong with sizzling seafood stir-fries, enjoys an elegant yum cha at Michelin-starred Man Wah, and ends the day sky-high at Ozone.

programs.title: Ainsley's Taste Of The Bahamas
programs.desc: Ainsley starts the day with Bahamian-style coffee and a morning fish dish at a beachside shack, then takes in some undersea art at the Clifton Heritage Park before plating up a plantain-and-sweet-potato rosti with crab salad for a full Bahamian breakfast.
